scope: Explicit caller-provided bounded English dictionary breaks in plain managed single-page PDF paragraphs. The library does not fetch or bundle a dictionary. Search highlights and justified geometry retain documented limitations; tagged, archival and native profiles are excluded.

local.releaseBuild: All five targets and the net472 test executable compiled in Release with one MSBuild worker.
local.net472: Actual Framework execution was not performed on Linux.
local.packageVerification: Serial local core, fonts and OCR 1.5.0 packs passed framework API and archive verification against this source commit; no package was published.

independentEvidence.openXml: Open XML SDK 3.5.1 reported zero schema errors for the independent saved DOCX and three exact-source test DOCX specimens. The validator apphost initially lacked DOTNET_ROOT; running the same validator DLL through the installed dotnet host succeeded.
independentEvidence.readers: Pinned Poppler, pypdf and PyMuPDF recover the logical word without an artificial hyphen. The selected break matches the independently licensed test-only US English dictionary, the visible hyphen outline matches the selected font within 0.05 pt, and changed DOCX/blank PDF controls are rejected.
independentEvidence.knownFailures: Search highlighting covers only the first line. The independent LibreOffice justified reference differed by 0.580002 pt at the word origin and 2.258973 pt at the following-line top against the unchanged 0.5-pt bound; a left-aligned substitute and changed source were rejected by controls. Both limitations are diagnosed; Strict rejects the search-geometry loss.
